info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Rosemary Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Rosemary Battery Detail Creation API facilitates the addition of detailed specifications for Rosemary battery products within the catalog. Businesses can utilize this endpoint to input essential product information, ensuring that their offerings are accurately represented and easily searchable. This API is ideal for manufacturers and retailers looking to enhance their product catalogs with comprehensive data. By streamlining the creation process, it promotes better organization and accessibility of battery details for potential customers.

post.summary: Create details for the rosemary battery.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create and submit detailed information about a rosemary battery. It is designed to handle the specifics of the battery's configuration and specifications, ensuring proper documentation for future reference and use.

requestBody.description: The request body to create or update details for a rosemary battery operation. This request requires specific details about the rosemary battery such as its specifications and operational parameters.
